why: Issue #1014. The markup's label for Reroll Seed drifts from the catalogue's -- the stale word on a button that still dispatches its id, which is the failure the catalogue being the single source exists to stop. The labels are in the markup since #1014 (so a button has an accessible name before the catalogue loads with the pane), and the comparison with `DEV_ACTIONS` is what holds them to it.
